title: Monetizing AI — Alvaro Morales, Orb
talk_summary: This is a B2B billing/monetization talk from Orb's CEO about how AI companies should price their products (add-on vs bundled, token vs task vs outcome-based pricing, and simulating pricing scenarios on usage data). It contains no engineering techniques for building or operating agents.

takeaways.what_they_do: They replay real product-usage events through alternate pricing structures (flat add-on fee, per-token, tiered) to compare topline revenue and per-customer impact before committing to a price.
takeaways.evidence_quote: AI builders should always simulate first before putting something out to market
